values: 一名擅长驱使幽魂的法师，能够在战斗中持续吸血。
A mage skilled in commanding ghosts, capable of stealing health during combat.
Chaos holds no place in my soul.
舍弃悲伤，才能获得力量。
Strength blooms only when sorrow fades.
May the spirits guide your path.
Such kindness, to call me beautiful—thank you.
好啦、好啦，出来玩一会儿吧。
How about a little playtime, just for now?
谢谢你，一直陪在我身边。
Thank you... for always being by my side.
真没想到，我还能收到这样美好的礼物……
I never thought I'd be given such a delightful gift...
Thank you, I truly appreciate it.
就让所有的哀伤停留在过去。
以冰雪为丝线织就的华服，世上仅此一件。
This exquisite garment, woven from threads of snow and ice, is one of a kind.
金玫瑰高定商店兑换获得。
Every corner here overflows with cheer.
Ah, Niru... my heart aches for your touch.
戴蒙一定会喜欢这个味道
生前，貌美又手巧的雪米拉喜欢上青年医生尼汝的原因很简单：她觉得他专注地做医学研究的样子很迷人。

In life, the radiant Shemira found her heart ensnared by the young healer Niru. There was something utterly enchanting in the way he lost himself to the pages of his medical texts, a charm that stirred her soul.
“我们一直很恩爱，直到战争开始、他随军离家后……”雪米拉叹了口气，“从那之后，一直到戴蒙去世，我都无法控制地恨着他。”

"We were in love... until the war called him away," Shemira murmured, her voice heavy with memory. "And from that moment on, until Daimon's last breath, I despised him with a fury I could not contain."
雪米拉和尼汝有个儿子名叫戴蒙。他很可爱，但从小体弱，怪病随身，连身为医生的尼汝都毫无治疗办法。
Shemira and Niru are blessed with a son, Daimon. He is a sweet child, but one marked by frailty from his first breath. A strange ailment clung to him beyond even Niru's skilled hands to cure.
雪米拉有着极其出色的缝纫手艺。在尼汝随军离家的那些年里，她不得不熬夜缝纫赚钱，以维持家中生计和戴蒙的医药费用。她的视力也因此变得很差。

Shemira is a master seamstress. While Niru served in the army, she spent endless nights sewing to earn enough coin to support her family and cover Daimon's medical care. As a result of her nightly labor, her eyesight grew worse.
“……听说她丈夫犯了杀人罪被处死了，儿子又病死了……她把眼泪都哭干了，眼睛也看不见了……唉，多可怜呐。”——雪米拉生前镇上老人的私语。

"I heard they hanged her man as a murderer, and her son died of illness... She wept until no tears remained, and even the light of eyes abandoned her... Such a cruel fate." —Whispers of the elders in town
有一天，已成为亡灵的尼汝突然归来，将病亡的戴蒙也复活为亡灵。雪米拉毫不犹豫地放弃了人类的生命，只为了与丈夫和儿子永不分离。

When Niru returned, no longer human but Graveborn, he breathed life into Daimon's still form and resurrected the boy. Shemira, seeing her family reunited in death's embrace, surrendered her mortal life without a second thought and joined them.
虽然在成为亡灵之后不再有视力上的困扰，但雪米拉还是喜欢用眼罩遮着双眼。或许，这是一种习惯，也是一种纪念。
Although her Graveborn transformation has restored her sight, Shemira still keeps her eyes veiled. Some habits transcend death, and it commemorates a woman who once gave up everything for her family.
“亲爱的雪米拉，不管是什么事，当然都是你说了算。”——尼汝。
"My dear Shemira, no matter what the matter is, you will always have the final say." —Niru
成为亡灵后的雪米拉，将所有的痛苦、怨恨和悲伤都舍弃了——她将这些悲怆情感凝聚为一颗充满魔力的宝珠，用这份力量来守护她的新生活。

Her transformation burned away her mortal anguish, purifying grief into protective energy. What once was sorrow now floats before her as a luminous sphere of condensed emotion. Her pain has become her power.
雪米拉将戴蒙看护得很严，甚至称得上是过度保护。因为她发誓不会再像生前那样让他遭受任何一点点欺侮和伤痛。

Shemira now watches over Daimon with fierce devotion. Some may even call her an overbearing mother. However, in this second life, she will not allow him to endure the sorrows that once plagued them when they were living.
戴蒙又跑到哪里去了？这孩子，真让人担心……
Where has Daimon gone this time? That boy... he's always a cause for concern.
